groups.account: Create, inspect and change game accounts.
groups.additem: Put an item in the selected player's bags.
groups.additemset: Add every item belonging to an item set.
groups.angle: Report the facing angle between you and your target.
groups.anticheat: Anticheat state for the selected player.
groups.aoedamage: Deal damage to everything around you.
groups.auction: Open an auction house window remotely.
groups.aura: Apply an aura to the selected unit.
groups.baninfo: Why a ban was applied and when it lifts.
groups.cast: Force a spell cast for testing.
groups.channel: Join or leave a chat channel as a GM.
groups.character: Character maintenance: rename, level, erase, restore.
groups.cheat: Per-session cheat toggles. Each takes on|off, or nothing to report state.
groups.cinematic: Author and preview cinematic camera paths.
groups.combatstop: Drop the selected unit out of combat.
groups.cometome: Make the selected creature walk to you.
groups.commands: List every command your security level can run.
groups.damage: Apply damage to the selected unit.
groups.debug: Developer probes. Mostly needs a player session and a selected unit.
groups.deleteitem: Remove an item from the selected player.
groups.demorph: Restore the selected unit's real model.
groups.deplenish: Drain the selected unit's health and power.
groups.distance: Distance from you to the selected unit.
groups.event: Game events: list, start, stop, enable, disable.
groups.explorecheat: Reveal or hide the whole map for a player.
groups.go: Teleport yourself. Needs a player session, so not usable from this panel.
groups.gobject: Create, move and inspect game object spawns.
groups.gps: Print your exact position, map, zone and area.
groups.group: Act on everyone in the selected player's group.
groups.groupgo: Teleport a whole group to you.
groups.guild: Create, rename, delete guilds and manage membership.
groups.harness: Test harness primitives, used by contrib/harness suites.
groups.hidearea: Hide an explored area from a player's map.
groups.hover: Toggle hover on the selected unit.
groups.instance: Instance bindings, saves and encounter data.
groups.itemmove: Move an item between your own bag slots.
groups.levelup: Raise or lower a player's level.
groups.linkgrave: Link a graveyard to a zone.
groups.list: Find spawns and item copies in the world.
groups.lookup: Search the game and account databases by name.
groups.maxskill: Cap every skill the player has.
groups.modify: Change a stat on the selected player. Most take one number.
groups.mount: Apply a mount display to yourself.
groups.movegens: Movement generator stack for the selected unit.
groups.mute: Silence a player's chat for a while.
groups.nameaura: Apply an aura to a named player.
groups.namego: Summon a named player to you.
groups.npc: Create, edit, move and delete creature spawns.
groups.partybot: Party bots. Run these in game: they act on your party and selection.
groups.pdump: Dump a character to a file, or load one back.
groups.pinfo: Account, level, money and location for one player.
groups.pool: Spawn pool inspection and forced rolls.
groups.possess: Take direct control of the selected unit.
groups.pvp: PvP flag for the selected player.
groups.quit: Shut the server down immediately. Console only.
groups.recall: Return a player to where they were last teleported from.
groups.reload: Re-read one world database table with no restart.
groups.removeriding: Remove riding skill from a player.
groups.repairitems: Repair everything a player is wearing.
groups.replenish: Refill the selected unit's health and power.
groups.reset: Reset a character's talents, stats, spells or level.
groups.save: Write your own character to the database.
groups.saveall: Write every online character to the database.
groups.send: Send mail, money or items, to one player or a race mask.
groups.server: World server state, limits, MOTD and shutdown.
groups.setskill: Set one skill's value on the selected player.
groups.showarea: Reveal one map area to a player.
groups.sniff: Packet capture for the selected session.
groups.spamer: Mute accounts flagged by the spam filter.
groups.stable: Open the hunter stable from anywhere.
groups.start: Teleport yourself to your race's starting area.
groups.taxicheat: Unlock every flight path for a player.
groups.unaura: Remove an aura from the selected unit.
groups.unit: Read fields off the selected unit.
groups.unstuck: Teleport yourself to your bind point.
groups.wchange: Set the weather in your current zone.
groups.whispers: Accept or refuse whispers while in GM mode.
groups.world: World update timing and visibility diagnostics.

commands.name: account
commands.desc: Your own account's security level and expansion.

commands.name: account create
commands.desc: Create an account at Player level. Both fields are uppercased and the password is capped at 16 characters.

commands.name: account delete
commands.desc: Delete an account and all of its characters.

commands.name: account lock
commands.desc: Lock your own account to the address you last used.

commands.name: account onlinelist
commands.desc: Accounts with a session open right now.

commands.name: account set addon
commands.desc: Expansion level the account may log in at.

commands.name: account set gmlevel
commands.desc: Security level, written to account_access. Realm -1 means every realm.

commands.name: account set locked
commands.desc: Pin the account to its last used address.

commands.name: antispam add
commands.desc: Add a phrase to the spam filter.

commands.name: antispam remove
commands.desc: Drop a phrase from the filter.

commands.name: antispam replace
commands.desc: Censor a phrase rather than block it.

commands.name: ban account
commands.desc: Duration is -1 for permanent, or a count with a unit: 10m, 2h, 7d.

commands.name: ban allip
commands.desc: Ban every address the account has logged in from.

commands.name: ban note
commands.desc: Attach a note to a character's record.

commands.name: baninfo account
commands.desc: When the ban was set, by whom, and when it lifts.

commands.name: banlist account
commands.desc: Banned accounts, optionally filtered by name.

commands.name: character aiinfo
commands.desc: Bot AI state for a character, if it is a bot.

commands.name: character clean items
commands.desc: Strip items that no longer exist in item_template.

commands.name: character clean todelete
commands.desc: Run the pending character deletion queue.

commands.name: character deleted old
commands.desc: Purge soft-deleted characters older than N days.

commands.name: character erase
commands.desc: Delete a character outright, no restore.

commands.name: character hasitem
commands.desc: Whether the character holds an item.

commands.name: character rename
commands.desc: Force a rename at the player's next login.

commands.name: character reputation
commands.desc: Every faction standing the character holds.

commands.name: commands
commands.desc: Every command your security level can run.

commands.name: event enable
commands.desc: Let the event fire on its own schedule.

commands.name: event list
commands.desc: Every game event and whether it is active.

commands.name: gm ingame
commands.desc: Game masters currently online and visible.

commands.name: groupinfo
commands.desc: Group the player is in, and its members.

commands.name: groupspell add
commands.desc: Put a spell in a stacking group.

commands.name: guild create
commands.desc: Create a guild with the player as leader.

commands.name: guild invite
commands.desc: Add a player to a guild.

commands.name: guild uninvite
commands.desc: Remove a player from their guild.

commands.name: help
commands.desc: Help text for one command, if the world table carries any.

commands.name: list creature
commands.desc: Where a creature entry is spawned.

commands.name: list item
commands.desc: Who holds copies of an item.

commands.name: list maps
commands.desc: Loaded maps and their instance counts.

commands.name: list object
commands.desc: Where a game object entry is spawned.

commands.name: list talents
commands.desc: Talent spells known by the selected player.

commands.name: lookup account ip
commands.desc: Accounts that have used an address.

commands.name: lookup account iponline
commands.desc: Accounts on an address right now.

commands.name: lookup account name
commands.desc: Accounts whose name contains the text.

commands.name: lookup player character
commands.desc: Characters whose name contains the text.

commands.name: lookup player name
commands.desc: Find the account behind a character name.

commands.name: notify
commands.desc: Large notification across every player's screen.

commands.name: partybot add
commands.desc: Spawn a bot into your party. Needs a player session.

commands.name: partybot aoe
commands.desc: Toggle area spells for the party.

commands.name: partybot attackstart
commands.desc: Send the party at your target, re-issued each tick.

commands.name: partybot caststop
commands.desc: Stop casting but stay in combat.

commands.name: partybot ccmark
commands.desc: Crowd control whatever carries this raid mark.

commands.name: partybot clearmarks
commands.desc: Drop every crowd control and focus mark.

commands.name: partybot clone
commands.desc: Spawn a bot copied from your selected player.

commands.name: partybot cometome
commands.desc: Walk the party to your position.

commands.name: partybot focusmark
commands.desc: Focus fire whatever carries this raid mark.

commands.name: partybot load
commands.desc: Bring an existing character in as a bot.

commands.name: partybot pull
commands.desc: Pull your target with the puller, or the named bot.

commands.name: partybot removeall
commands.desc: Remove every party bot you own.

commands.name: partybot unequip
commands.desc: Take an item off the selected bot.

commands.name: partybot usegobject
commands.desc: Have the party use your selected game object.

commands.name: pdump load
commands.desc: Load a dump file into an account.

commands.name: pdump write
commands.desc: Write a character to a dump file on the server.

commands.name: pinfo
commands.desc: Account, security, level, money, map and guild in one line.

commands.name: raidguild add
commands.desc: Create a persistent raid guild member.

commands.name: raidguild guild
commands.desc: Move a member into a guild.

commands.name: raidguild list
commands.desc: Every raid guild member and their spec.

commands.name: raidguild summon
commands.desc: Bring a member online and to you.

commands.name: reload all
commands.desc: Re-read every reloadable table. Heavy; prefer a narrower reload.

commands.name: reload command
commands.desc: Re-read the command table, including security overrides.

commands.name: reload config
commands.desc: Re-read mangosd.conf. Only settings marked live take effect.

commands.name: repairitems
commands.desc: Repair everything the player is wearing.

commands.name: reset all
commands.desc: Queue the reset for every character on the realm.

commands.name: reset honor
commands.desc: Clear honor points, kills and rank.

commands.name: reset items
commands.desc: Strip every item the character owns.

commands.name: reset level
commands.desc: Back to level 1 with starting stats.

commands.name: reset spells
commands.desc: Back to the class's starting spell book.

commands.name: reset stats
commands.desc: Recompute base stats for the current level.

commands.name: saveall
commands.desc: Flush every online character to the database.

commands.name: send items
commands.desc: Mail carrying up to twelve item stacks.

commands.name: send message
commands.desc: Pop a system message on one player's screen.

commands.name: server idlerestart
commands.desc: Restart once the server goes idle.

commands.name: server idleshutdown
commands.desc: Shut down once the server goes idle.

commands.name: server info
commands.desc: Core revision, players online and uptime.

commands.name: server log filter
commands.desc: Toggle one log filter at runtime.

commands.name: server motd
commands.desc: Show the current message of the day.

commands.name: server plimit
commands.desc: Player cap, applied live. A security keyword restricts login to that level and above instead of capping a count.

commands.name: server resetallraids
commands.desc: Clear every raid instance binding on the realm.

commands.name: server restart
commands.desc: Countdown, then exit with the restart code.

commands.name: server set motd
commands.desc: Set the message of the day.

commands.name: server shutdown
commands.desc: Countdown, then save every character and exit.

commands.name: spamer list
commands.desc: Accounts the spam filter has flagged.

commands.name: tele name
commands.desc: Teleport a player to a named game_tele location.

commands.name: ticket escalatedlist
commands.desc: Tickets escalated to a higher level.

commands.name: ticket onlinelist
commands.desc: Open tickets whose author is online.

commands.name: ticket reload
commands.desc: Re-read one ticket from the database.

commands.name: unmute
commands.desc: Restore chat for a muted player.

commands.name: variable
commands.desc: Read a world variable, or set it by passing a value.

commands.name: wareffort info
commands.desc: AQ war effort stage and resource totals.
